title: Quote Then Book Match
description: The price a customer is shown at checkout should be the exact price that lands on their invoice later — down to the cent, across several different package shapes, not just the one you happened to spot-check.
successCondition: For 3 different package/route combinations (varying weight and dimensions enough that some are weight-driven and at least one is volumetric-weight-driven per docs/api/booking.md's chargeableWeight formula), call POST /api/booking/quote and record priceCents/distanceKm/chargeableWeightKg for each. Then POST /api/booking with the identical inputs for all 3. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the 3 new rows confirms price_cents and distance_km exactly match their corresponding quote's values in all 3 cases — no case where the booked price silently drifts from the quoted price.
hints: Pick at least one case where lengthCm*widthCm*heightCm/5000 (volumetric weight) exceeds the raw weightKg, so chargeableWeight actually comes from volume — that's a distinct code path from the plain-weight case.

The server always recomputes price server-side from the request body (FR-704, docs/api/booking.md) — any client-supplied price field is ignored, so there's no shortcut around doing the quote call first.
